DEPOSIT RE- TURN SCHEME HELPING ST CANICE’S PARISH HOMES Troys Court is a community-based centre providing 20 independent living units, a day care centre and a home meal delivery service (Meals on Wheels). You can support th is invaluable facility by donating your unwanted empty cans and bottles. A collection bin is co nveniently located at Talbot’s Inch Filling Station (De Loughry’s), where donations can be dropped off at anytime. Your generosity and support for this initiative will make a real difference to the lives of our elderly neighbours availing of these services. Every donation, no matter how small, will be greatly appreciated . Raffle on the n ight. Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat | 11th-13th December 2026 Calling all young people aged 16 –35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and worksho ps, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catho lics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland. Ossory Youth Ministry Team – Advent Youth Mass The Ossory Youth Ministry Team invites young people, families, and the wider community to join us for a special Advent Youth Mass on Sunday, 29 November 2026 , the First Sunday of Advent. The Mass will take place in St. Canice’s Catholic Church, Dean Street, Kilkenny at 11.30am and will be a wonderful opportunity for young people to come together in faith, prayer, and celebration as we begin the Advent season and prepare our hearts for the coming of Christ. Music for the celebration will be provided by students from local secondary schools, bringing their gifts and talents to enhance the liturgy and create a joyful and prayerful atmosphere. All are warmly welcome to join us as we begin our journey through Advent together. Fr. Willie Purcell -
